main_text.p: Salia fixa, volatilia, acida, spiritus, ef- fervescentiam, &c. quasi in his solis Me- dicina, quanta quanta est, resideret. Quasi vero hæc Sylvius ex Hippocra- te non potuisset hausisse. Sed hac de re paulò post, unde manifestum fiet non quidem in his solis, quod Sylvio, reclamante Veritate, assuere annititur Versutus orator, sed in his præcipuè Medicinam consistere. Sylvio igitur objicere non erubescit peculiarem Chymiæ cognitionem, quod multis locis ingeminat; quasi illud semel ef- futivisse non sufficeret, atque piacu- lum esset novisse naturæ penetralia, callere Anatomiam, quâ abditi natu- ræ recessus referantur: corporum prin- cipia explicantur: quâ remotis scoriis aquæ, spiritus, olea, acida & salia tùm fixa tùm volatilia, uti & composita medicamina minus fastidiosa & maxi- mè efficacia conficiuntur: quâ deni- que omnium δυναμέων, ut loquitur Hip- pocrates, sive potentiarum & faculta- tum

page.notes: Several words are set in damaged or blurred type at line ends; the Greek word δυναμέων is printed in a smaller italic form and is transcribed as best read. The scan is faint at the left edge, so the first words of some lines are partly lost.
